Existing crop state supplies lifecycle delays and germination sum. Exact FKT committed receipt alone retires the window.

bootstrap privately retains existing accepted-window objects; callers cannot construct or inject a window
invariants: Only actually accepted hydrology admits window contribution

Rejected hydro and crop trials do not advance committed state or event delivery

continuation_contract.representation: Opaque serialization-neutral application continuation; existing F-KT persistence snapshots retain the parameter certificate and owner provenance; immutable file source bytes, existing weather owner and accepted/delivered windows travel together.
continuation_contract.configuration: Private deep copy of the originally validated bounded file-weather configuration, not caller-reconstructed physical coefficients or numeric source IDs.
continuation_contract.restore: Only a fresh/closed application and an uninitialized crop carrier; all source snapshots validate before startup publication. No overwrite or rollback of a live owner.
continuation_contract.scientific_scope: Continuous next-day physical execution after disposal and restoration of the real application, crop carrier and bound crop executor. Not a disk codec or external archive format.

local_O0_O2: PASS: continuous and joint-restored four-day execution identical, including full profile pressure/water/surface/ledger/Richards history and crop bits

initial_day_successor_contract.authority: Existing initialize_fmr_wofost_crop_transaction_state plus kernel_committed_state%initialize; no FKT interval/event semantics are altered.
initial_day_successor_contract.source: Existing certified weather/soil daily preflight and daily lifecycle composition derive initial prepared/sown/germination fields from authentic first source day.
initial_day_successor_contract.publication: Creation of one previously-uninitialized existing crop carrier, at actual initial accepted soil time/revision zero; not an invented positive accepted hydro window or a zero-duration FKT trial.
initial_day_successor_contract.exactly_once: Positive stable crop identity/lineage and uninitialized target required; repeat or late initialization fails before publication. Original crop continuation inputs remain owner-derived thereafter.
initial_day_successor_contract.completed_phases: Existing prepared/sown flags prevent re-running completed entry conditions; already germinated state uses existing mode0 no further temperature-sum accumulation while emergence remains unimplemented.
initial_day_successor_contract.restart: Opaque continuation distinguishes initial crop creation and pending next-day event from already consumed event; accepts only private actual owner provenance and publishes only fresh owners.
initial_day_successor_contract.limits: Scheduled sowing and root-free/no-heat profile; does not qualify simulated thermal sowing, emergence, WOFOST growth, root/rotation/fallow or disk codec.
